name: 11th Hour Racing grants (Ecosystem Restoration focus area)
summary: Project grants, typically one year, for nonprofits, favouring local pilot projects with measurable outcomes; one of three focus areas is coastal habitat restoration. Priority to the US East Coast, Puerto Rico, Hawaii and the Caribbean.

eligibility.rule: Funding tied to a specific project with measurable outcomes
Not general, capital, infrastructure or endowment funding

status.quote: 11th Hour Racing's grant application period has closed for the year.

administered_by.quote: Under the 11th Hour Racing umbrella, activities are provided through 11th Hour Racing, Inc., which serves as the impact entity

applicant_types.quote: We prioritize projects led by 501(c)(3) organizations, but other types of nonprofit or charitable entities may apply

geography.quote: We award grants in the U.S. and globally

access.quote: 11th Hour Racing's grant application period has closed for the year.

amount.quote: Typical grant awards range from $40,000 - $150,000, with an average grant size of $75,000.

eligibility.quote: Our grant funding must be tied to a specific project with measurable outcomes.
We currently do not offer general funding, capital or infrastructure grants, or endowment funding.
